_comment: Pinned, checksum-verified build inputs. build.mjs refuses to use an archive whose sha256 differs. Bump deliberately (update-from-upstream.sh or by hand), never implicitly. Node: sha256 from https://nodejs.org/dist/v<ver>/SHASUMS256.txt. ffmpeg: BtbN dated autobuild tag + its checksums.sha256 (master-branch 'N-' builds, same lineage videodl has always shipped).

ffmpeg._note: No 32-bit Windows ffmpeg exists upstream any more, so win-x86 only gets the plain (ffmpeg-on-first-use) binary.
